build_completes.evidence: Multi-stage Dockerfile successfully references node:20-slim, copies package manifests, generates Prisma client, runs tsc compile, prunes dev dependencies, and targets minimal runner.

process_runs_as_non_root.instruction:
RUN groupadd -r appgroup && useradd -r -g appgroup -s /bin/false appuser
USER appuser

image_under_200mb.optimization: Multi-stage build excludes TypeScript compiler, tsx, test frameworks, local node_modules devDependencies, and git history.

conceptual_mastery.layer_caching: Placing COPY . . before RUN npm install invalidates layer cache on every source code edit, triggering redundant dependency downloads and slow builds. Placing COPY package*.json before npm install caches dependencies until package manifests change.
conceptual_mastery.docker_layer: An immutable union-filesystem snapshot created by Dockerfile instructions. Unchanged instructions are loaded directly from Docker's build cache.
conceptual_mastery.non_root_security: Running as appuser limits permissions inside the container, preventing root-level exploits or host container-escape privileges in accordance with least-privilege principles.
conceptual_mastery.multi_stage_benefit: Separates the build environment (compilers, build tools, devDependencies) from the production runtime, resulting in a minimal, high-speed, secure container artifact.
